actual_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE full-body transparent visual-novel fear sprite of Valeriy from Genshin Impact. Preserve his dark layered hair, violet irises, navy-gold uniform, diagonal sash, chain, double belts, pale purple-lined fur-edged cape and tall boots. Preserve the exact armor asymmetry: silver armor on his LEFT shoulder and arm, fur and cape at his RIGHT shoulder. Retain his Tall Male proportions and broad shoulders without elongation or added bulk. Shift his weight back with both feet still planted, right open palm raised near his chest to caution someone, armored left arm bent protectively at waist level. Fear restrained by training. Use his normal iris and pupil design from the neutral; ordinary eyes without alternate symbols. Change pose, head angle and body language to act this emotion; do not retain the neutral pose and change only the face. Hands should stay near the torso and mostly in the image plane: each visible hand has a palm, four naturally articulated fingers and one separate opposable thumb, clearly distinct from sleeves. Exactly two arms, two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet separated or only slightly staggered; no crossed legs or extreme foreshortening. Keep one coherent mouth. Entire silhouette, hair, cape or coat tails, both hands where visible and both boot soles inside frame; 92–96 percent visible height with 2–4 percent top/bottom padding. One isolated character on genuine transparent alpha. No scenery, props, weapons, floor, cast shadow, UI, labels, watermark, floating symbols or effects. This is a new expression candidate for user review.
